mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises above 0.5%, signaling tightening monetary policy, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 7% and PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 in a month, signaling a strong labor market, S&P 500 forward returns are positively affected over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:strong labor markets boost consumer spending
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or joint Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO, indicating improved industrial production, enhances productivity and efficiency, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of easing cycle instances with positive INDPRO growth, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST, signaling strengthened housing demand, positively affects S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as it indicates overall economic health.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 45% of months with positive HOUST growth, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.035 over any 2.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds a 3-month average increase of 0.5%, indicating rising inflation, and FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, the mismatch leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or joint Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always, the level of UNRATE, as a standalone indicator of labor market conditions, inversely correlates with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, due to its broad economic implications.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between UNRATE and SPX 20d returns remains above -0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or SPX produces positive returns in > 40% of instances with high UNRATE.

failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of post-shock recovery instances with RSAFS above $400,000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
